name: Education & Learning Platform

designIntent.primaryGoal: Help learners understand what to do next and track progress without distraction.
designIntent.visualThesis: A guided learning environment where instruction and progress are easy to follow.

visualDirection.density: low-to-medium for learning content; denser in teacher/admin workspaces
visualDirection.surfaces: distinct learning content from navigation and progress metadata
visualDirection.colorIntent: calm base with consistent semantic progress and feedback; test color contrast
visualDirection.typography: comfortable reading size and line length; clear lesson, prompt and feedback roles
visualDirection.motion: purposeful progress feedback; no distracting loops

layout.pattern: course navigation + lesson content + progress/next-step area
layout.spacing: generous around learning content, concise around curriculum navigation
layout.responsive: lesson content remains primary; navigation becomes a clear drawer or step list

accessibility.keyboard: all learning activities and media controls must support keyboard interaction
accessibility.focus: visible focus and predictable return after dialogs
accessibility.reducedMotion: no essential lesson information depends on animation

notes: Content structure and readability matter more than decorative education-themed illustrations.

aiGuidance.primaryFlow: Orient to a learning goal → resume or choose a lesson → study → practice → receive feedback → continue or review.
prioritize: The current learning objective and lesson content
Progress that accurately reflects completed work
Feedback, resources and the next meaningful activity
confirmOrMarkUnknown: Learner age range, language and reading level when relevant
Whether progress is local, synced or teacher-managed
avoidByDefault: Unverified grades, certificates or learner outcomes
Walls of text without headings or practice checkpoints
acceptanceChecks: Learners can identify the current objective and next action
Lesson content remains primary on small screens
Feedback explains why an answer is correct or needs review

compositionEscapes.when: The learner arrives to resume or complete a specific lesson.
compositionEscapes.composition: Lead with lesson title, objective and learning content; keep course outline and progress/next-step controls in supporting navigation.
contentRequirements: Current progress and next lesson state
avoid: A marketing dashboard between learner and lesson

compositionEscapes.when: The primary task is choosing, planning or navigating a multi-module course.
compositionEscapes.composition: Use a structured course map showing modules, prerequisites and completion states; reveal lesson detail when a step is selected.
contentRequirements: Clear locked, available and completed states

compositionEscapes.when: The main activity is answering questions, solving exercises or applying knowledge.
compositionEscapes.composition: Focus on one exercise or a coherent short set; keep instructions, response area and feedback together.
contentRequirements: Clear prompt and allowed response format
Expected answer or rubric supplied by content owner
avoid: Premature answer disclosure when practice is the goal
